text.tspan: Municipal and federal election voter turnout in 2025
Data source: Elections Canada (2025); "After a low-turnout election with a postal disruption, St. John's eyes election reform",
CBC News (2026); Élections Québec (2025); Elections Calgary (2025).
Municipal election data collected as of October 13, 2026. **Federal election voter turnout was calculated as the mean voter
turnout for all federal electoral districts within the municipality.
Number of votes per 10 registered voters
